PayPal Standard Payouts. Mauritius is 'send, receive and withdraw' in PayPal's country table (https://developer.paypal.com/docs/payouts/standard/reference/country-feature/) and Stripe publishes no MU corridor at all. GBP not MUR: the Mauritian rupee is not one of PayPal's payout currencies (https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/currency-codes/), so a MUR row would refuse every payment made over it. ProviderManaged and RequiresProviderOnboarding false because a PayPal payout goes to an address the member already has, not to an account this platform onboards. Payload, idempotency and duplicate handling confirmed against a live sandbox account by LivePayPalSandboxTests, 8 Sep 2026 - see docs/financial/paypal-adapter.md for what those runs found.
